form.label: Skills & career
form.description: Endorsements describe exported activity, not proficiency. Year/month career dates retain their original precision.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | eval label=snapshot_time." — ".status | fields label export_id
index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | head 1 | fields export_id

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | dedup export_id | table snapshot_time snapshot_time_basis status actual_records warning_count export_id

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=endorsement_received | stats count AS Endorsements BY skill | sort - Endorsements | head 20

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset IN (endorsement_given,endorsement_received) time_basis=activity | timechart span=1mon count BY dataset

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset IN (skill,endorsement_received) | eval declared=if(dataset="skill",1,0), received=if(dataset="endorsement_received",1,0), skill=coalesce(skill,name) | stats max(declared) AS declared sum(received) AS endorsements BY skill | where declared=1 AND endorsements=0 | table skill

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=position | table company title location started_on started_on_precision finished_on finished_on_precision
`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=education | table school_name degree_name start_date end_date
